diagnostic_source_snapshot.scope: Exact executed private diagnostic worker source, provided for method review. It requires a separately admitted plan, compatible raw references and source inputs; it is not a standalone benchmark command.

interpretation: All ten Object tasks have every official demonstration recorded under the declared restored-pose contract. The original three-task paired regression remains distinct from seven later unpaired cohorts. Recorder controls add no baselines; the ketchup validation-failure control is post-hoc and does not replace validation outcomes. This is native execution and record coverage, not source-history reconstruction, physical accuracy, policy evaluation or full130completion.
artifact_scope: Public per-case result summaries, hashes, audit findings and the executed diagnostic source. Full raw trajectories and resource archives remain separately retained; these JSON summaries alone cannot independently re-audit every native step.
source_identity_scope: baseline_candidate_commit identifies the original restored-pose source candidate; the unchanged execution/scoring source hashes and each packet identity govern the added cohorts, whose packaging commits may differ.
